title: Rose
tagline: Smart storage solution built on top of IPFS & Filecoin, benchmarking deduplication process, and optionally enabling proof of ownership using ERC721. BUIDL for humans.
description: Our project is a user-friendly platform designed for anyone to easily store and create images online. With this platform, you can securely save your pictures and access them quickly thanks to our fast delivery system. If you want to turn your images into unique digital items called NFTs, we offer a marketplace where you can buy, sell, and trade these assets across multiple blockchain networks. Our platform ensures that your images are safe, easy to share, and can even be transformed into valuable digital collectibles. No technical expertise needed! #Web3 #NFT #AI #DigitalArt #SecureStorage
how_its_made: Our project is a comprehensive decentralized platform designed for users and developers to store file assets, with integrated CDN capabilities for efficient delivery. Utilizing Filecoin and IPFS for robust and secure storage. For seamless interactions and identity management, ENS is employed for human-readable naming, while Fleek provides hosting and CDN services. Additionally, users have the option to convert their assets into NFTs for proof of ownership, which can be traded across a multi-chain marketplace, ensuring broad accessibility and interoperability within the blockchain ecosystem. This platform not only offers secure storage  but also empowers users with the ability to monetize and trade their digital assets in a decentralized manner.
